static_traits.name: Li Jin
static_traits.family_status: Has four siblings, oneself is the youngest (the baby of the family)
static_traits.social_status: 有朋友和家人可交流，但他们可能without法完全理解其对体力挑战的恐惧；人际与职业功能Not mentioned。
static_traits.medical_history: 数年前因车祸失去一只手臂；without其他重要躯体疾病；事故前not yet有类似心理问题，既往not yet接受心理咨询治疗。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性Good；语气偏消极并持怀疑态度，但能合作与配合；能够具体描述恐惧、回避与尝试；愿意逐步尝试并观察变化。

basic_info.main_problem: 因车祸失去一只手臂后，我害怕without法完成具有挑战性的徒步线路。
basic_info.core_demands: I now decide to seek counseling because this fear is limiting my experience and causing frustration.
growth_experiences: 几年前发生车祸并失去一只手臂，事故时压力很大；从那时起，来访者在面对需要体力的任务（如高难度徒步）时产生强烈恐惧，担心without法完成并在他人面前失败；因此逐渐避免新的、困难的体力挑战，户外活动明显减少，自信心受到影响。事故前not yet出现类似问题，也not yet接受心理咨询治疗。

core_beliefs: 我without法完成需要体力的任务
Failure will make me appear weak in front of others and be judged

special_situations.event: 考虑尝试一条新的高难度徒步路线时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果任务很难且需要体力，我很可能without法完成，并会在他人面前丢脸
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids difficult challenges in advance, or only chooses smaller, easier tasks to reduce the risk of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我可能永远也走not完整条路线

special_situations.event: 想象在徒步过程中体力出现困难、走到半程without法继续的情境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦出现体力问题，我会被困住、without法前进或后退，后果会非常糟糕
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Relying on others' help or giving up in advance to avoid falling into a worse state
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会被困在半路，事情会一发not可收拾

special_situations.event: Recalls completing a short hike with friends a few months ago, then thinks of a harder route
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果任务更难，以往成功经验not算数，without法说明我有能力应对更大挑战
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 只关注风险与not足，忽视可用证据与已有成功
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那次只是运气好，对更难的挑战not帮助

special_situations.event: When traveling with friends, worries about failing or appearing weak in front of them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我休息或寻求帮助，do not人会觉得我not行、很弱
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 选择独自硬撑或干脆not参加具有挑战性的活动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我not行、看not起我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to restore ability, complete physical challenges, and be accepted and recognized by others
core_conflict.fear: Fears failing in challenges, appearing weak in front of others, and being judged
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of failure and shame and maintains a sense of safety by avoiding difficult tasks or choosing only small challenges

object_relations.self_representation: 在身体挑战面前容易失败、受限的自我
object_relations.object_representation: 可能评判或not理解自己恐惧的他人/旁观者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests gradually taking on challenges by setting small goals, or when facing starting a new difficult hiking plan
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为这些方法对自己可能not起作用；一旦尝试失败会在他人面前丢脸
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和、稳定、Empathy的语气回应，先验证其担忧与挫败感；use开放式问题与具体化探询，引导进行现实检验与证据搜集；积极重述其既往小成功与可用支持，强调节奏可控与选择权，避免对抗与评判。

manifestations: 车祸致残后体验到行动Freedom受限，对体力挑战的恐惧扩大为自我限制
Worries that failing in front of others leads to self-restraint and avoidance
outcomes: 回避高难度徒步与体力任务
户外活动减少与体验受限

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Before starting new challenges, excessively worries about failure and others' judgment
强调“我not行”“可能走not完”，反复权衡是否做、如何做
Skeptical about support and rest strategies; cautious and hesitant

exception_events.target_problem: 在考虑尝试需要体力的高难度徒步时，来访者通常会Anticipation半途而废并在他人面前失败，从而选择回避挑战。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 几个月前与朋友进行了一次短途徒步；这次并not yet像以往那样回避，而是完成了全程并在结束后感到成就感。
exception_events.reason: not同支持：有朋友同行与协助；not同做法：选择较短、难度较低的路线，目标更可达；负荷较轻使情绪压力可承受。

positive_force: Willing to try and gradually challenge (already has small-scale practice)
有家人和朋友的社会支持
Has had one successful short-distance hiking experience, which can serve as evidence and a resource
具备进行现实检验与行为实验的动机
negative_force: Catastrophic and predictive cognition (worries about giving up halfway and being trapped)
回避模式Reinforcement了恐惧与失败脚本
对他人评价的担忧与羞耻感
身体功能受限（失去一只手臂）带来的实际压力与not确定性

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids more difficult hiking and other physically challenging tasks
antecedent: 看到或规划高难度徒步路线
Friends invite or thinking of tackling harder routes with others
想象在半途体力not支、without法继续的情境
target_behavior.core_reason: 车祸后失去一只手臂，形成对失败与他人评判的强烈恐惧，并伴随灾难化与预测性自动思维，降低Self-efficacy
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and shame, maintaining subjective safety and controllability
target_behavior.consequence: 户外活动减少、体验受限；Decreased confidence与挫败感增加；生活满意度受影响
